basics.name: Punit Mishra
basics.title: Senior Machine Learning Expert & AI Tech Lead
basics.summary: Applied AI engineer and technical leader with 14+ years taking machine learning from prototype to dependable production at enterprise scale. Not only an architect — I implement, deploy, and own systems end to end, from agent runtimes and LLM inference pipelines through GPU deployment on custom H100 clusters and production scaling. As Senior ML Expert and AI Tech Lead in SAP CX Data & AI, I lead a team of thirteen and personally build the agent orchestration, memory, multi-model serving, and multi-tenant infrastructure beneath our LLM products — delivered in direct forward-deployed partnerships.

experience.position: Senior Machine Learning Expert & AI Tech Lead — CX Data & AI (CXAI)
experience.summary: Lead and personally build the agent orchestration, LLM serving, and multi-tenant infrastructure beneath SAP CX's LLM products.
highlights: Built and own end to end a domain-agnostic conversational agent platform — a memory-managed runtime with multi-tenant LangGraph orchestration, fronted by an agent gateway and MCP-based service hub; implemented performance-critical paths in Rust

Introduced Ray for distributed AI workloads and built/deployed LLM serving on custom bare-metal H100 GPU clusters, owning the full lifecycle from infrastructure bring-up through production inference and scaling
Stood up multi-model LLM serving — self-hosted internal models alongside frontier models (Claude, Qwen, Granite-class) on Kubernetes, with automated benchmark and evaluation harnesses
Shipped natural-language-to-SQL turning business questions into validated queries — shipping within SAP's 2026 public and private cloud releases
Re-architected vision capabilities (visual-attribute extraction, object detection, visual search) into gRPC agent services; PyTorch + CLIP embeddings backed by vector search and RAG (Qdrant, FAISS)
Designed multi-tenant identity and provisioning: cross-service internal-auth contract and tenant-resolution model unifying IAS and XSUAA, plus automated SaaS tenant provisioning (CAP / cds-mtxs)

Lead a team of thirteen engineers across three workstreams; set architecture direction via ADRs and serve as forward-deployed engineer on the platform's first production enterprise customer (a global retailer)

Established the CI/CD and delivery backbone: PR-test gates on ephemeral environments and GitOps promotion (dev → prod) via Argo and Piper on Kubernetes / Kyma (Gardener). SAP Security certified; own AI ethics & compliance
Built the Thunderbridge AI backend on Dataiku
Designed multi-tenant ML and CI/CD across Oracle, Vertica, SAP HANA, and HDFS
Ported the full ML stack to GKE on-prem (Anthos) with Istio

experience.summary: Automation and test engineering for financial-services clients.
highlights: Built reporting and data-validation automation for JPMorgan Chase
Built reusable Selenium / Java test frameworks adopted across the firm
